_comment: Curated, dated fall-colour reports and outlooks gathered from public web sources on 2026-10-11. kind: observation | outlook | model | practical. Coordinates were assigned by the curator to the place the report describes; county-wide items are pinned to a representative point and flagged scope=county.

reports.summary: Axios Seattle: Seattle's most vibrant foliage is forecast for Nov 1 to 7, later than most of the U.S.; Snohomish, Leavenworth, Yakima and the Cascade foothills peak first. Storms could strip leaves early.

fallphotoguide.com latitude/elevation model lists King County's typical peak as Sep 22 to 30 and calls the county 'past peak' on Oct 5 (median elevation 1,651 ft). This is a coarse model, not an observation, and conflicts with lowland reports.
hikewa.app Snoqualmie-region conditions (updated Oct 4): 'Fall colors appearing now' on Granite Mountain; colour also noted around Talapus, Olallie and Melakwa Lakes.
Subalpine huckleberry and mountain-ash colour reported at Talapus and Olallie Lakes (Snoqualmie region conditions page, Oct 4).

MyNorthwest: dry week offered a good window for colour viewing; higher-elevation trees turn first and 'some lowland western Washington trees are already turning color', with more varieties expected through October.

Seattle finished its coldest September since 2007; early October started dry and mild with the next rain expected Fri/Sat Oct 9-10 (FOX 13). Cool nights without hard frost favour gradual colour development.
FOX 13: Puget Sound lowlands typically peak mid-to-late October; this year's warm, dry summer (about 1 F above average) could push colour earlier in stressed trees.

UW Botanic Gardens seasonal highlights: October is the Arboretum's main colour month (Japanese maples, witch hazels, black gums, sorrel trees, buckeyes, mountain ash). Regional guides put peak in late October with colour holding into November.
Kubota Garden Japanese maples turn deep red through late October; free, dawn to dusk. Guided fall-colour tours are listed for Oct 19-20 and 26-27 (verify with the garden).
reports.source: Seek Seattle / UW Hort Library listing

reports.summary: Gold Creek Pond (Snoqualmie Pass) is closed for a multi-year restoration project; use Hyak, Franklin Falls or Denny Creek for pass-area vine maple instead.

morethanjustparks foliage tracker: statewide peak modelled Sep 29 to Oct 8; Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF vine maple best around Oct 6-9 with colour to about Oct 21; bigleaf and vine maple peak near Oct 15 in the North Cascades.
Local guides: trees along the Green Lake loop begin turning gold in early October.
